title: Extra Utility Functions for R

what: Add an image to a Word document — docx_add_img
title: Add an image to a Word document — docx_add_img
text: Adds image Word document optional captioning auto-numbering. Images larger page margins automatically scaled fit within available page space preserving aspect ratio.

title: Add an image to a Word document — docx_add_img
code: docx_add_img(   x,   src,   width,   height,   units = c("in", "cm", "mm", "px"),   dpi = 300,   caption = NULL,   caption_pos = c("below", "above"),   autonum = NULL,   fp_t = NULL,   fp_p = NULL )

title: Add an image to a Word document — docx_add_img
text: x rdocx object, created officer::read_docx(). src Path image file. width, height Image size units expressed units argument. units One following units width height arguments expressed: "", "cm", "mm" "px". Default "". dpi Plot resolution. used units = "px". Default 300. caption text display image caption. NULL (default), caption added. caption_pos Position caption relative image. One "" "". Default "". autonum Auto-numbering (e.g., automatically generate "Figure 1: "), created officer::run_autonum(). NULL (default), auto-numbering added. fp_t Text formatting properties caption text, created officer::fp_text(). Note affect styling auto-numbering (use prop argument officer::run_autonum() ). fp_p Paragraph formatting properties applied entire paragraph (image, caption, auto-numbering), created officer::fp_par().

what: Read an Excel file with multiple header rows — read_excel_multi_headers
title: Read an Excel file with multiple header rows — read_excel_multi_headers
text: Reads one sheets Excel file (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xlsb) multiple header rows (often involving merged cells). rows automatically collapsed form single row column names.

title: Read an Excel file with multiple header rows — read_excel_multi_headers
code: read_excel_multi_headers(   file,   sheets = 1,   n_headers = 1,   sep = "_",   skip_empty_rows = TRUE,   skip_empty_cols = TRUE,   simplify = TRUE,   ... )

title: Read an Excel file with multiple header rows — read_excel_multi_headers
text: file path existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xlsb file. sheets <tidy-select> Sheets read. Defaults 1 (first sheet). n_headers Number header rows top sheet combine single row column names. Defaults 1. sep String used separate text header cell combining single column name. Defaults "_" (e.g., "Header1_Header2"). skip_empty_rows, skip_empty_cols TRUE (default), rows columns contain missing values removed. simplify TRUE (default) one sheet read, return single data frame. FALSE, always return named list data frames. ... Arguments passed openxlsx2::wb_to_df start_row,start_col Optional numeric values specifying first row column begin data discovery. row_names Logical; TRUE, uses first column selection row names. skip_hidden_rows,skip_hidden_cols Logical; TRUE, excludes rows columns marked hidden worksheet metadata. rows,cols Optional numeric vectors specifying exact indices read. detect_dates Logical; TRUE, identifies date datetime styles conversion. na character vector named list (e.g., list(strings = "", numbers = -99)) defining values treat NA. dims character string defining range. Supports wildcards (e.g., "A1:++" "-:+5"). show_formula Logical; TRUE, returns formula strings instead calculated values. named_region character string referring defined name spreadsheet Table. keep_attributes Logical; TRUE, attaches metadata internal type table (tt) types attributes output. show_hyperlinks Logical; TRUE, replaces cell values underlying hyperlink targets. apply_numfmts Logical; TRUE, applies spreadsheet number formatting returns strings.

title: Read an Excel file with multiple header rows — read_excel_multi_headers
text: data frame (one sheet simplify = TRUE) named list data frames.

title: Read an Excel file with multiple header rows — read_excel_multi_headers
text: function processes requested sheet individually. column sheet, header rows combined vertically single name, separated sep. process, value merged cell propagated every cell merged range, missing whitespace-cell values ignored, consecutive duplicate values deduplicated. example, column "Demographics" merged across two cells, followed blank cell "Age" cell, cleanly collapses "Demographics_Age" (rather "Demographics_Demographics__Age"). Finally, column names repaired ensure uniqueness, data types automatically guessed import. merged cells sheet (just headers) unmerged, cell range receiving original merged value. Header collapsing performed empty rows columns removed (skip_empty_rows skip_empty_cols TRUE), n_headers refers first rows resulting sheet.

title: Read an Excel file with multiple header rows — read_excel_multi_headers
code: library(openxlsx2) #>  #> Attaching package: ‘openxlsx2’ #> The following object is masked from ‘package:officer’: #>  #>     read_xlsx  # Create a workbook with a merged header spanning two columns wb <- wb_workbook()$   add_worksheet("Sheet1")$   add_data(x = "Demographics", dims = "A1")$   merge_cells(dims = "A1:B1")$   add_data(x = "Name", dims = "A2")$   add_data(x = "Age", dims = "B2")$   add_data(x = "Alice", dims = "A3")$   add_data(x = 30, dims = "B3")  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx") wb$save(tmp)  read_excel_multi_headers(tmp, n_headers = 2) #>   Demographics_Name Demographics_Age #> 1             Alice               30

what: Save a plot to a file — save_plot
title: Save a plot to a file — save_plot
text: Adapted ggplot2::ggsave(). general-purpose plot-saving function works R plotting system. Accepts ggplot objects, grid objects, plotting call wrapped function. Unlike ggplot2::ggsave(), supports ggplot grid objects, save_plot() can capture plotting call (e.g., base R) wrapping function (e.g., function() plot(1:10)).

title: Save a plot to a file — save_plot
code: save_plot(   plot,   filename,   device = NULL,   path = NULL,   width = NA,   height = NA,   units = c("in", "cm", "mm", "px"),   dpi = 300,   ... )

title: Save a plot to a file — save_plot
text: plot Plot save. ggplot object, grid object, plotting call (e.g., base R) wrapped function (e.g., function() plot(1:10)). filename File name create disk. device Device use. Can either device function (e.g. png), one "eps", "ps", "tex" (pictex), "pdf", "jpeg", "tiff", "png", "bmp", "svg" "wmf" (Windows ). NULL (default), device guessed based filename extension. path Path directory save plot : path filename combined create fully qualified file name. Defaults working directory. width, height Plot size units expressed units argument. supplied, uses size current graphics device. units One following units width height arguments expressed: "", "cm", "mm" "px". dpi Plot resolution. ... arguments passed graphics device function, specified device.

title: Save a plot to a file — save_plot
text: named list (returned invisibly) elements: file: Full file path. width: Plot width. height: Plot height. units: Units width height. dpi: Plot resolution.

title: Save a plot to a file — save_plot
code: tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png") save_plot(function() plot(1:10), tmp, width = 5, height = 4)

title: xtra (development version)
text: New read_excel_multi_headers() reads Excel files (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xlsb) multiple header rows (often merged cells) need collapsed single row column names. Supports tidy-select sheet selection automatic type guessing. New save_plot() saves R plot (ggplot, grid, base R wrapped function) file. Adapted ggplot2::ggsave(), broader support arbitrary plotting calls. New docx_add_img() adds image Word document optional captioning auto-numbering. Large images automatically scaled fit within page margins. New merge_headers() vertically extends header cells contiguous single-space padding rows flextables created gtsummary objects. cells merged resulting area rectangular.
